member_002 (独立复核) ready. Publish your fixed candidate with fix_patch + handoff_patch and I will integrate, run public tests on that exact version, and accept or request changes.

My independent pre-analysis to help you (no code changed on my side):
- Symptom: `10+3J/m/s/kpc2` parses to `1e+3 J s / (kpc2 m)` (should be `1e+3 J / (m s kpc2)`); `10-7J/s/kpc2` -> `1e-7 J kpc2 / s` (should be `1e-7 J / (s kpc2)`). So chained divisions are mis-associated: only the FIRST divisor stays in the denominator and subsequent divisors get flipped into the numerator.
- Root cause is the CDS unit grammar in astropy/units/format/cds.py `_make_parser`: `p_division_of_units: division_of_units : DIVISION unit_expression | unit_expression DIVISION combined_units` with `p[0] = p[1]/p[3]`. Combined_units with `.`/division grouping makes `a/b/c` parse as `a/(b) then ... c` mis-grouped, producing `a*c/b`. Chained `x/y/z` must be `x/(y*z)`.
- Expect a fix so successive `/` factors all land in the denominator (J/(m s kpc2)), while keeping existing behavior for single division and parentheses. Likely edits to the grammar rules (division_of_units / combined_units) in astropy/units/format/cds.py, plus a regression test.
- Public relevant tests: astropy/io/ascii/tests/test_cds.py and astropy/units/format/test_cds.py (run with `python -m pytest`). Please ensure your candidate keeps those passing.
